name: The Presidio and the Golden Gate Bridge
note: The south tower of the Golden Gate Bridge (1937) with about 500 m of the main span, the south approach over Fort Point, the toll plaza and the Battery lands, and the Presidio's north edge along Crissy Field. Turned 5.34 degrees clockwise so the bridge deck (south tower to north tower, OSM) runs straight along z. Scale 0.5 blocks per metre so the 227 m tower stands about 114 blocks over the water.
